notes: US News 2026 rank is a tie at No. 4 with Harvard. Women percentage nulled: per Poets&Quants, Kellogg omitted gender and diversity data from its official Class of 2027 profile; a 41.4% figure appears only in secondary coverage of uncertain provenance. GRE averages were not seen in authoritative snippets. All Class of 2027 profile figures read from the official profile page's embedded stat data this session; page states all data are specific to the incoming Two-Year MBA class. Kellogg does not publish gender data for the Class of 2027 (no mention of women on the profile page), and no acceptance rate is published on official pages; the prior US News-sourced 31.4 acceptance figure could not be replaced with an official one. GMAT middle 80 pct ranges and GRE averages were read from the page's chart data (values embedded in the page source).
